name: Indrelon
description: The Magic Mirror that reveals the location of the High King.

description_citations.text: "Will Kenrith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Peter helps carry the cauldron through a threshold to Talion's court, where Talion names Hylda as the next witch and the mirror Indrelon as the way to find her.
timeline.quote: "But consult the mirror Indrelon, and you may yet find her ."

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Troyan tells the mirror something new, and it shows an ice castle at Loch Larent where Hylda lies.
timeline.quote: Beneath the condensation, he sees a castle of ice, faceted and glittering

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Four undines help Rowan Kenrith's group across a river to meet Indrelon in exchange for knowledge and secrets.
timeline.quote: Four undines assisted Rowan Kenrith 's group across a river to meet with Indrelon in exchange for knowledge and secrets.

citation.text: "Merfolk", section "Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eight or nine generations before the Wildered Quest, mankind overthrows the Elven Lords, the five knightly courts are created, and Vantress is established around Indrelon.
timeline.quote: The court of Vantress was established around Indrelon .

citation.text: "Vantress", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Indrelon is stolen and moved to Stormkeld; Will Kenrith abandons Ardenvale for Vantress and has wizards encase Wicked Slumber victims in glass caskets.
timeline.quote: Indrelon was stolen from Castle Vantress and moved to Beluna Grandsquall 's castle, Stormkeld.

citation.text: "Vantress", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The twins quest for their abducted father; Will rescues Garruk, summoning the Cauldron of Eternity which cures him.
timeline.quote: Later on, Will rescues Garruk from certain death.

citation.text: "Will Kenrith", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Gerra tore the mirror from Castle Vantress
relations.quote: Torn from Castle Vantress by Gerra Grandsquall
